reason: Radix Dialog.Root and Dialog.Portal render no element and closed Overlay/Content are not mounted; a server-rendered Stimulus port needs one controller host (Trigger cannot host it: zero, one or several triggers, or controlled open) and somewhere to ship the closed markup. Neither element carries a data-slot, classes or layout (display: contents / template), so the compared DOM is unchanged.
api: Sheet renders one <div style="display: contents" data-controller="chadcn--sheet"> host with no data-slot, classes or other data attributes besides controller wiring
closed Portal children (Overlay, Content) are server-rendered inside a <template> in the host and mounted into document.body on open

Sheet takes id: (no Radix prop): the id of the content, the other generated ids being <id>-<part>; Radix numbers ids with React's useId (unique per tree, no caller control); the port numbers them per request with the Rails engine and per render otherwise (Chadcn::Sequence), and the root takes an explicit base
